details: Liveness/readiness bypass application Redis rate limiter. Readiness requires PING,750ms deadline, shared in-flight probe prevents queue growth. Real owned Redis pause: liveness under500ms, readiness503 under1000ms, recovery200 and exact room/snapshot preserved on Node25/22. Own Redis stopped. Initial recovery fixture was corrected to await completion of its released PING before probing recovery.
benefit: A Redis interruption no longer makes the running game server appear dead; readiness reports the actual problem and recovers.
limits: Same original server failure set; R25 partial
